current.text: He is 37 and recovering from a torn ACL. He will not be ready for the start of the season. Yahoo lists him as out (knee).
Experts expect him back around January. The range is Christmas at the earliest to February. On 2026-10-13 Josh said he does not know when Butler will play.
Once he returns, experts expect limited minutes and no back-to-back games.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for the second most in the league.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.
Only take him with your last pick, after round 12, and only if you have a free IL slot. Drop him once you need that slot. Taking him in round 10 was called an insane pick.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year.
The team may care about lottery odds and rest veterans, which adds rest risk for a 37-year-old coming off an ACL tear.
His return is expected to take wing minutes from other Warriors and reshape the rotation.

durable.text: His game is built on IQ, cutting, physicality and drawing free throws, not on explosiveness.
When he plays, his value comes from FT% on good volume, steals and assists for a forward. He makes few threes for his position.

note: He went for 22 USD in our league last season, but now Yahoo prices him at 1 USD (rank 146) and ESPN at 0.5 USD (rank 214). He is out with a torn ACL until about January and is expected to come back on limited minutes with no back-to-backs. At most he is a 1 USD last pick for a team with a free IL slot, more likely a waiver add. When he plays he helps FT%, steals and assists and fits punt 3PM builds. Around Christmas, check his return date, his minutes and whether the Warriors start resting veterans.
